$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers, shared via git. Claude Code asks each user to
approve these once before they load.
context7 provides live, version-correct API docs. It is here because the three
libraries this repo leans on hardest all break signatures between releases and
are exactly what plan files guess wrong about: yfinance 0.2.66 (fetch/columns
semantics), pandas-ta-classic 0.6.52, and discord.py 2.7.1 (embed and slash
command surfaces). pandas 2.3 / numpy 2.4 deprecations too.
Requires node (verified: v24.16.0) and network access on first run.
CONTEXT7_API_KEY is optional; set it in the environment for higher rate limits,
never in this file - it is committed.
